mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_inventory (id, material_id, location_id, batch_no, container_code, ownership_type, consignor_id, quantity, first_inbound_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{materialId}, #{locationId}, #{batchNo}, #{containerCode}, COALESCE(#{ownershipType}, 'OWNED'), COALESCE(#{consignorId}, ''), #{quantity}, COALESCE(#{firstInboundTime}, NOW()), #{createBy}, NOW(), #{updateBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW()
mapper.sql:
FROM wms_inventory i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id AND m.deleted_at = 0 JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id AND l.deleted_at = 0 JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id AND w.deleted_at = 0
LEFT JOIN wms_customer c ON c.id = i.consignor_id AND c.deleted_at = 0

SELECT i.id, i.material_id, i.location_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.spec, m.unit, i.batch_no, w.warehouse_code, w.warehouse_name, w.status AS warehouse_status, l.location_code, i.container_code, i.quantity, i.locked_qty, (i.quantity - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty, i.ownership_type, i.consignor_id, COALESCE(c.customer_name, '') AS consignor_name, i.first_inbound_time,
DATEDIFF(#{q.asOfDate}, i.first_inbound_time) AS stock_age_days
DATEDIFF(NOW(), i.first_inbound_time) AS stock_age_days

where.if: AND (m.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.materialKeyword}, '%') OR m.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.materialKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: ORDER BY i.material_id ASC, i.location_id ASC, i.batch_no ASC, i.container_code ASC, i.ownership_type ASC, i.consignor_id ASC

AND (i.material_id, i.location_id, i.batch_no, i.container_code, i.ownership_type, i.consignor_id) > (#{lastMaterialId}, #{lastLocationId}, #{lastBatchNo}, #{lastContainerCode}, #{lastOwnershipType}, #{lastConsignorId})
ORDER BY i.material_id ASC, i.location_id ASC, i.batch_no ASC, i.container_code ASC, i.ownership_type ASC, i.consignor_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(w.erp_stock_code,''), w.warehouse_code) AS erp_warehouse_code, w.warehouse_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.kingdee_code,''), '') AS erp_material_code, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, COALESCE(i.batch_no, '') AS batch_no, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty, SUM(i.locked_qty) AS locked_qty FROM wms_inventory i JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.quantity <> 0
AND i.ownership_type = #{ownershipType}
AND i.ownership_type = 'OWNED'
AND i.update_time >= #{windowStart} AND w.warehouse_code IN #{c} GROUP BY erp_warehouse_code, w.warehouse_code, erp_material_code, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, COALESCE(i.batch_no,'')

SELECT DISTINCT i.location_id FROM wms_inventory i JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(w.erp_stock_code,''), w.warehouse_code) = #{warehouseCode} AND m.kingdee_code = #{materialCode} AND COALESCE(i.batch_no,'') = #{batchNo}
AND i.ownership_type = 'OWNED' AND (i.quantity > 0 OR i.locked_qty > 0) ORDER BY i.location_id
